name: What is the process City Dweller, LLC follows for trip hazard removal in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the process City Dweller, LLC follows for trip hazard removal in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: City Dweller, LLC begins with an initial consultation to understand your concerns and assess the living room's current state. We then conduct a detailed inspection to identify all trip hazards, structural issues, and potential solutions. Based on this, we provide a transparent proposal outlining the recommended work, timeline, and cost. Upon approval, our team executes the removal or repair efficiently, ensuring minimal disruption and adherence to safety standards. We conclude with a final walkthrough to ensure your satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: City Dweller, LLC assesses hazards, provides a detailed proposal, efficiently executes the removal/repair, and conducts a final walkthrough in your Bay Area home.
